2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offence under Sections 406, 420,
467, 468, 504, 506, 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. At the outset, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in this case, dispute between parties has been settled through process of mediation which fact has come in order dated 12.5.2025, passed by this Court in Cr.Mis.No. 6879/2025 by which co-accused Ravindra Kumar @ Pappu Yadav has been granted pre-arrest bail.
4. Learned counsel for the informant does not dispute Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.62998 of 2025(2) dt.05-12-2025 the contention made on behalf of petitioner and confirms the fact regarding settlement entered into between the parties.
